sourceSemantics.funding: ConcreteStandardVaultImpl._deposit caller -> vault transferFrom before mint. No prefunding.
sourceSemantics.queue: ConcreteAsyncVaultImpl._executeWithdraw -> AsyncVaultHelperLib.executeQueuedWithdraw spends allowance, escrows owner shares, receiver owns request.
sourceSemantics.cancelClaim: caller-only wrapper entrypoints; open-epoch cancellation returns shares; processed-epoch claim pays USDT to caller.
sourceSemantics.rounding: UserActionsLib + Conversion.sol floor deposit/redeem, ceil mint/withdraw; virtual +1 supply/assets; processing/claims floor.
sourceSemantics.feesHooks: Yield accrual before four user calls; hooks mutable, observed zero. Strategies, offchain custody and accounting not isolated by this inventory.

Integrators should be aware of the existence of deposit fees. - MUST NOT revert. NOTE: any unfavorable discrepancy between convertToAssets and previewMint SHOULD be considered slippage in share price or some other type of condition, meaning the depositor will lose assets by minting.

Integrators should be aware of the existence of withdrawal fees. - MUST NOT revert. NOTE: any unfavorable discrepancy between convertToAssets and previewRedeem SHOULD be considered slippage in share price or some other type of condition, meaning the depositor will lose assets by redeeming.

Management/performance fees may mint dilutive shares; current rates, profit, backing and future yield are not assured.

Queue active was true at observation: withdraw/redeem do NOT immediately pay underlying. They spend owner-to-caller share allowance when caller differs from owner, transfer shares from owner into the vault, and credit current-epoch request to receiver, not owner. Receiver controls cancellation and claim; intentional third-party receiver is economically significant. Return values are current conversion estimates, not a guaranteed eventual exact asset payout.

Epoch closure/processing require WITHDRAWAL_MANAGER and are deliberately not admitted. Processing fixes the then-current epoch price, burns escrowed shares, and reserves assets only if sufficient idle liquidity exists. Strategy unwinds/custodial operators can delay it; there is no guaranteed maturity or payout time. Manager may partially process or move requests between epochs. Queue activation and cancellation eligibility are mutable.

cancelRequest(uint256) returns only caller-credited pending shares, only while that epoch is open and cancellation enabled. claimWithdrawal(uint256[]) claims only caller-credited requests for processed epochs, clears those requests, and pays floor-rounded USDT directly to caller; no caller-selected payout recipient or arbitrary user overload is admitted. Each epoch ID must be processed and aggregate claim must be nonzero.

Deposit caps, minimum transaction deposits, min/max withdrawal amounts, pause checks and configurable pre/post/transfer hooks can restrict use. getHooks returned zero target/flags at observation, not a guarantee. Configured strategy 0x3115db16cea7a56c054344b6e8517611cbfefbc0 was observed but not independently admitted or attested; official docs describe offchain Safe/Fordefi custody and bounded external accounting, not isolated onchain-only backing.
